items.title: Quot of O^{oplus r} on P^n_Z with Hilbert polynomial P is proper over Z
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove Quot^P_{O^{oplus r}/P^n_Z/Z} is proper over Z: separated and lfp from lemma-quot-s-lfp and valuative existence from lemma-quot-existence-part reduce properness to quasi-compactness; build the universal parameter space T = Spec(Z[a_{i,j,E}]) over multi-indices E of degree m (m from varieties-lemma-bound-quotients-free, N = r·binom(m+n,n) - P(m)) with the universal matrix Psi of degree-m homogeneous polynomials; stratify T by generic flatness (more-morphisms-lemma-generic-flatness-stratification) so Q = Coker(Psi) is flat on the stratum differences, giving morphisms from the Noetherian strata unions into the Quot functor; surjectivity: a k-point with quotient O^{oplus r} -> F has m-regular kernel K, so K(m) is globally generated with vanishing higher cohomology and dim H^0(K(m)) = chi(O(m)^{oplus r}) - chi(F(m)) = N, hence F is the cokernel of a matrix Psi_x with coefficients lambda_{i,j,E} in k, and the ring map tau: A -> k, a_{i,j,E} |-> lambda_{i,j,E} yields a point of T mapping to x.
